goal: Begin the structured chat_export_mining cartridge shell: manifest, schema, bounded runner contract, fixture plan, receipt format, and first validation tests. Does not implement the full cartridge.

governance/chat_export_mining/CARTRIDGE_.description: Declares cartridge_id, stage, status, Stage001 bounded scope (does/does_not), future_stages roadmap, dependencies on merged machinery.

governance/chat_export_mining/CHAT_EXPOR.description: Schema for a single Claude Code session JSONL export entry. Documents required_for_mining fields, filter_condition (hook_event_name == PostToolUseFailure), and graceful-handling notes.

governance/chat_export_mining/BOUNDED_RU.description: Contract for runner.py: invocation flags, exit codes, guarantees (no ledger writes, no /mnt/data, no network), receipt_shape. Explicitly documents what is NOT in Stage001 scope.

governance/chat_export_mining/runner.py.description: Bounded JSONL runner. Reads lines, skips blanks/parse-errors, filters PostToolUseFailure, calls map_payload (no classify), emits JSON receipt. Flags: --input, --output, --max-entries, --dry-run.

files: malformed_entry.jsonl — 6 lines, 2 bad JSON, 1 valid failure, 1 unmappable

classes: TestRunnerUnit (15 tests — mine_stream() unit tests with synthetic JSONL)
TestFixtureFiles (10 tests — JSONL fixtures are well-formed and produce expected counts)
TestManifestAndContracts (16 tests — JSON documents are valid and structurally complete)
TestRunnerSubprocess (14 tests — CLI invocation matching real usage patterns)
TestExistingSuiteNotBroken (3 regression guards for all prior test suites)

design_decisions.no_ledger_writes_in_stage001: runner.py calls map_payload() only (not adapt_and_classify). This means Stage001 produces a receipt of mapped blocker events without writing to the ledger or making any recurrence decisions. Recurrence tracking is Stage002.
design_decisions.stream_processing: mine_stream() consumes lines one at a time so memory stays constant regardless of export size. This is required for future ingestion of large chat790 exports.
design_decisions.parse_errors_not_fatal: Bad JSON lines are counted as parse_errors and skipped. The runner exits 0 unless there is an I/O failure or an internal error. A partially-malformed export should still yield whatever valid entries it contains.
design_decisions.unmappable_counted_separately: PostToolUseFailure entries with no tool_name yield adapter status UNMAPPABLE and are counted in the receipt's unmappable field, not mapped. They do not crash the runner.
design_decisions.max_entries_flag: --max-entries enables safe sampling of large exports before committing to full ingestion. Useful for Stage002 dry-runs.
design_decisions.dry_run_flag: --dry-run parses and counts all entries but emits events=[] and dry_run=true in the receipt. Safe for validation without producing output artifacts.
design_decisions.no_decision_field_on_events: Stage001 events have no 'decision' key (LOG_ONLY/FORCE_RCA/LOG_NEW_VARIANT). Those fields appear only after classify() is called in Stage002+. Tests assert this invariant explicitly.

hard_constraints_respected: Did not implement the full cartridge in one pass
Created only the Stage001 cartridge shell (manifest, schema, contract, runner, fixtures, tests)
Did not claim full chat export mining is complete
Did not access /mnt/data or claim native MetaBlooms OS source patching
Did not start the actual chat790 export ingestion
Did not bypass or remove the PreToolUse guard
Used merged hook/adapter/router machinery (map_payload imported from post_tool_failure_adapter.py)
limitations: Stage001 does not write to the ledger; recurrence patterns across an export are invisible until Stage002
Fixture JSONL files are synthetic (not from actual /mnt/data/Metablooms_OS chat exports)
No deduplication across JSONL lines: if the same failure appears twice in the export, it produces two mapped events
No session-aware grouping: events from the same session are not correlated
runner.py does not validate field types within entries — it relies on the adapter's graceful handling of missing/malformed values
next_stage_recommendation: CHAT790_EXPORT_MINING_CARTRIDGE_STAGE002 — ledger feed: pipe mapped events through adapt_and_classify() to track recurrence across all failures in a chat export, producing a receipt with per-fingerprint occurrence counts and FORCE_RCA candidates
